item.title: Majority in new poll considers Trump dangerous, corrupt
item.description: A recent Economist/YouGov poll shows a slight majority of registered voters describe President Trump as corrupt and dangerous.

item.title: Judge Again Blocks Kennedy Center Effort to Add Trump's Name
item.description: A federal judge ruled Tuesday that the Kennedy Center's latest attempt to add President Trump's name to the performing arts center violated his earlier order.

item.title: Trump-Aligned Kennedy Center Board Votes to Close Building
item.description: The Kennedy Center's board voted Tuesday to close the iconic performing arts center's main building for a renovation project backed by President Trump.

item.title: Massie Moves to Impeach Pete Hegseth Over Iran War
item.description: Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) introduced a resolution Tuesday to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of defying Congress and acting illegally.
